fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Create ONE finished square 1:1 watercolor book illustration for adult readers. Two wide scenes stacked vertically show the SAME PINK person making friendships across generations: sharing an older friend's memories in youth, then making a fresh memory with a younger friend decades later. Keep the story warm and equal, without a child-care or dependent-elder relationship.

LAYOUT AND CHARACTERS
Upper scene first, lower scene decades later, separated by a narrow clean white paper gap. Soft irregular watercolor boundaries and generous white outer margins.
PINK is the central person in BOTH scenes, exactly the same pink color, circular head, minimal face, medium neutral adult proportions and a few fine short upper-outer eyelashes. Upper pink is a YOUNG ADULT without glasses/wrinkles. Lower pink is older, with round glasses, a few fine eye-corner wrinkles and a mild natural forward shoulder bend, while retaining the same neutral body and head.
The upper friend is an OLDER TURQUOISE adult wearing thin round warm-brown glasses and a few short fine wrinkles. The lower friend is a YOUNG YELLOW ADULT with a few short fine eyelashes, modest dark oval eyes and a cheerful open smile. Plain colored bodies, no special clothes.

UPPER: A MEMORY SHARED
Pink sits toward the left and turquoise toward the right on a simple brown wooden park bench with dark metal supports. They lean gently toward one another and share an OPEN PHOTOGRAPH ALBUM held naturally across their laps. Pink's hand points to a picture while turquoise supports the album; both have warm happy faces. Turquoise's eyes can be small smiling closed-eye curves inside the glasses.
The park has a substantial tree toward the left, a soft blue lake beyond the bench, a quiet green bank and path, a few understated flowers and distant trees. Both seated figures' complete legs and feet are visible beneath the album; bench supports and floor placement are sensible.
A small cream paper-like heading toward the upper-left reads exactly:
"جوانی"
THE ALBUM'S PHOTO ORIENTATION IS ESSENTIAL: the PEOPLE sit BEHIND the open album, while the viewer sees its front edge. Both photographs must be correctly UPRIGHT FOR THE PEOPLE READING THEM, so the image contents look UPSIDE DOWN TO THE VIEWER IN FRONT. The left photo is a small landscape, oriented toward the readers. The right photo is a snowman with a black top hat: the snowman's HAT AND HEAD are near the page's LOWER/FRONT EDGE closest to the viewer, while its rounded base is toward the UPPER/BACK EDGE nearer the readers. Do not make the pictures face the viewer for easier display. The book itself is held in a physically plausible position, not upside down as an object.
No speech bubble or other text in this upper scene.

LOWER: A FRESH EXPERIENCE, MANY YEARS LATER
A genuinely different sunny TOWN SQUARE with a low pale stone wall, a simple stone arch to the right, soft terracotta-roofed buildings and a few quiet shrubs/flowers. No copied park bench or lake panorama and NO OLD PHOTO ALBUM anywhere in this scene.
The SAME pink now older stands toward the left beside young adult yellow on the right. Both full bodies and feet are visible. Older pink has simple round glasses, fine wrinkles and a slight relaxed forward shoulder bend; pink's hands rest together naturally at the front of the neutral body. Pink smiles happily, eyes optionally closed in small friendly curves inside the glasses.
Yellow's near arm rests gently around pink's upper back/shoulder in ordinary friendly companionship; the other arm extends upward to the right holding a smartphone for a selfie. The PHONE SCREEN faces BOTH FRIENDS, its BACK and small camera lenses face the viewer. Both friends look toward the phone and enjoy a newly shared memory. A couple of small motion/attention strokes by the phone are acceptable, but no additional symbols.
Heading toward the upper-left of this lower scene:
"سال‌ها بعد"
No dialogue, other captions, age numbers, English or labels on phone/photos. This fresh setting and activity make the passage of time believable while the pink person's identity stays clear.

For smiling closed eyes, use small simple dark curved marks, never white eyeballs. Fine eyelashes sit only on the same modest eye design. Older posture is a small natural shoulder bend, not a curved gendered torso.

STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN
Use authentic moderate hand-painted layered watercolor on luminous textured white paper. Broad softly irregular overlapping translucent washes are visible inside heads, torsos, arms, hands and legs, as well as the scenery, with varied pigment density and subtle local pooling. Colors are warm and clear with restrained soft shading. Preserve a natural painterly finish, not flat/vector coloring, marker, uniform fine colored-pencil grain, glossy plastic/3D, repetitive embossed texture, heavy mottling or decorative splashes.
Every head is a PERFECT CIRCLE with equal width and height, an uninterrupted circular contour, no oval, chin, jaw, flattened lower arc, ears, hair or nose. Head joins shoulders directly WITHOUT A NECK. A soft darker crescent of the same local body hue beneath the head separates it from the upper torso without creating a neck segment.
All bodies have balanced medium adult proportions, neither plump/chibi nor spindly or excessively stretched. All genders use the same simple neutral structure: gently almost-parallel torso sides, natural unshaped pelvis, coherent limbs and naturally aligned legs. No breasts, tiny waist, waist notch, projected hips, separate buttock bulge or gendered contours. Fine short upper-outer eyelashes, where specified, are the principal female cue and must not change the eye design.
Eyes are modest small dark ovals with an optional TINY light glint INSIDE, never white sclera surrounding a pupil or large doll eyes. Simple eyebrows and small expressive mouths. No sharp flat pink circular cheek spots; blush is absent or only barely perceptible diffuse translucent watercolor.
Each openly visible hand has exactly THREE FINGERS PLUS ONE THUMB, with natural gripping or folded-finger occlusion allowed. Body contours use darker versions of the SAME LOCAL BODY COLOR, not black; facial details and Persian letters may be dark.
Full figures, feet and important objects stay within scene boundaries; natural furniture/boat/prop occlusion is allowed but no body part or object is cut by file or panel edges. Clear irregular watercolor boundaries, generous CLEAN WHITE PAPER outer margins, narrow white gutters, no heavy panel borders. Polished thoughtful adult-book art, warm, kind, quietly witty and family friendly.
All in-image writing is ONLY the short verbatim Persian text specified for that scene, with accurate connected letters and right-to-left direction. No English, extra captions, numbers, watermark or signature. The pictured actions communicate the idea without an explanatory moral caption.
